sources.label: Ethereum asset() and cooldownDuration() at block 26088256 (2026-09-30)

reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26088256 on 2026-09-30, asset() on the tracked sYUSD vault 0xfe0ccc9942e98c963fe6b4e5194eb6e3baa4cb64 returned tracked YUSD 0x4274cd7277c7bb0806bd5fe84b9adae466a8da0a and cooldownDuration() returned 604800 seconds. This independently confirms the exact wrapper parent and seven-day redemption cooldown. Reward accrual changes the exchange rate rather than the backing identity.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact Ethereum vault asset() and cooldownDuration() reads at block 26088256
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The linked YUSD backing is disclosed; dynamic reward accrual is not modeled as a separate reserve slice.

providers.name: Ethereum sYUSD ERC-4626 vault 0xfe0ccc9942e98c963fe6b4e5194eb6e3baa4cb64 and its cooldown silo

custodyProfile.reviewer: Sol curation pass 2026-10-01 (CurM06UTY); owner ruling D08 follow-up (OwnerFollowups)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The onchain custodyModel describes wrapper-local custody of deposited YUSD in the Ethereum and BSC sYUSD vault contracts and the Ethereum cooldown silo. On 2026-10-01, asset() identified chain-local YUSD at Ethereum block 26098750 and BSC block 125134867; Ethereum totalAssets() exactly matched YUSD balanceOf(vault). The current Ethereum and BSC implementations reject rescueTokens when token == asset(), and ERC-4626 deposit/mint transfers the parent asset into the vault before minting shares. These implementation constraints do not remove the reviewed proxy-upgrade authority. Under owner ruling D08, YUSD's underlying strategy custody risk remains on yusd-aegis through the existing parent dependency; this wrapper review does not establish upstream custodians, allocations, segregation, bankruptcy protection, or reuse rights. No provider shares are inferred.
